controlled.artifact_scope: candidate attribution, unseen generalization and limited causal edge; no merge between scientific evidence levels
controlled.capability: same B35 functional SAE replacement at assistant query and same upstream writes at an equal offset before assistant query, 2200 exposed formal monitor +140 reference, paired exact bounds, 2pp margin, two-op family correction; native CUDA only.
controlled.causal: T discovery group at prequestion token only, whole native write removal: clean, joint .5/1, attention-only, MLP-only, matched random joint. Full original downstream forward. One hash-frozen R,T pair per unseen lockbox background, both questions. Primary outcome location generated accuracy loss ≥.10, paired exact p<.05, and target-minus-random loss ≥.05; random must match total discovery RMS within ±25% in each writer class. Report I, frozen residual margin, next-token KL and log odds as secondary.
controlled.design: T=location, R=assignment, I=T xor R, Q=query. For each background all 8 combinations. Q suffix follows the shared prequestion readout.
controlled.gate: Discovery pilot first 32 backgrounds, minimum 14/16 in every R/T/Q/frame cell. Each heldout cell minimum 90% generated first-word accuracy, 80 queries per cell.
controlled.observation: Capture all native query-head outputs, every MLP output up to B34, embedding and residual boundaries at the shared prequestion token; paired 4-variant per-background contrasts for T/I and frozen discovery decoder; Q suffix and pre-selector controls.
controlled.selection: T primary, I secondary. For each variable fit unit direction using mean discovery oriented pairs in native incoming B35 residual. Rank writer classes by mean contribution along this direction. Freeze top two positive mean Head writes and top two positive MLP writes for each variable (or fewer if nonpositive). Test both assignment orientations and both holdouts.
